hero.title: Mtskheta Riviera
hero.subtitle: Cruise the Ancient Waters of Georgia
hero.description: Experience the magic of Mtskheta from the Mtkvari River. Scenic boat tours beneath centuries-old cathedrals, lush willow trees, and breathtaking mountain views.

about.title: Discover the Experience
about.subtitle: Where History Meets the River
about.description: Mtskheta Riviera offers an unforgettable river cruise experience in Georgia's ancient capital. Glide along the Mtkvari River and witness the stunning Svetitskhoveli Cathedral, Jvari Monastery, and the confluence of two great rivers.

cruise.title: River Cruises
cruise.description: 2-hour scenic cruises along the Mtkvari with panoramic views of Mtskheta's UNESCO heritage sites.
